guide.title: What to Do in Case of Death?
guide.lead: Stay calm. We support you step-by-step through all organizational and official tasks.
guide.step1Text: Contact the attending physician or emergency medical service at 116 117. The doctor issues the official death certificate.
guide.step2Text: Call us directly at 02336 - 44 38 18. We sensitivity coordinate immediate steps and arrange dignified transfer.
guide.step3Text: ID card, family registry / birth certificate, marriage certificate, pension numbers & health insurance card.
guide.step4Text: Choose burial type, music, and service format without rush in your family circle. We advise you openly.

preplanning.title: Funeral Pre-Arrangement – Peace of Mind
preplanning.lead: Pre-planning gives you the certainty of deciding your final journey yourself while completely relieving your family.
preplanning.benefit1Text: You specify burial type, location, music, eulogist, and service format in advance.
preplanning.benefit2Text: Protected funding through an interest-bearing trust account (BT Treuhand) or funeral insurance.
preplanning.benefit3Text: Prevents disagreements and financial burden for your loved ones during emotional times.

services.title: Dignified Ways to Say Goodbye
services.lead: Every person is unique. We provide compassionate guidance for all burial formats.
services.earthDesc: In-ground coffin burial in a cemetery setting with a personalized grave site.
services.earthDetail1: Mandatory Timeline in NRW: Burial within 8 days of death.
services.earthDetail2: Grave Formats: Selectable family plot or sequential grave.
services.earthDetail3: Location Choice: Local residence or open cemetery choice in Schwelm & NRW.
services.earthDetail4: Significance: A physical place of remembrance and solace for loved ones.
services.fireDesc: Cremation with a subsequent urn ceremony at a cemetery or columbarium.
services.fireDetail1: Procedure: Cremation in coffin with or without prior funeral ceremony.
services.fireDetail2: Urn Placement: Urn grave, family plot, columbarium niche, or urn meadow.
services.fireDetail3: Affordable Option: Urn community graves with name stele (e.g. from €299 cemetery fees).
services.fireDetail4: Timeframe: Allows relatives more time to organize a meaningful ceremony.
services.treeDesc: Eco-friendly urn burial at the roots of a tree in a designated memorial forest.
services.treeDetail1: Maintenance Free: Nature manages grave care through changing seasons.
services.treeDetail3: Partner Forests: FriedWald, RuheForst, Trostwald Odenthal & Macpela Waldesrast.
services.treeDetail4: Symbolism: A comforting sign of life's eternal natural cycle.
services.seaDesc: Scattering of a biodegradable urn in the North or Baltic Sea with a dignified boat ceremony.
services.seaDetail1: Maritime Ceremony: Biodegradable urn lowered by captain following sea tradition.
services.seaDetail2: Sea Ports: Hooksiel, Juist, Norderney, Timmendorfer Strand, Niendorf & Scheveningen.
services.seaDetail3: Nautical Map: Relatives receive a detailed map excerpt with exact coordinates.
services.seaDetail4: Options: Silent burial or accompanied by family on board.
